question: In the MPU polling whole-module context, does a folded unsigned check of the success flag in the retry loop prevent its BP home from sharing the retry-counter slot? Both versions have the same 171-byte instruction sequence; seven operand bytes differ. The original eliminated expression is unknown and the positive is STEERED.

expect.live_flag@0: sub ax, ax; mov word ptr [bp - 4], ax; mov word ptr [bp - 6], ax
expect.plain_retry@0: sub ax, ax; mov word ptr [bp - 2], ax; mov word ptr [bp - 4], ax
